description: Zona de Servicio de los Puertos de la Generalitat Valenciana is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by intranet.gva.es. The coverage contains the service area, attached or in the process of being assigned, of the ports managed directly or under concession of the Generalitat Valenciana. INTERNAL USE LAYER of the competent Conselleria. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Service Zone of the Ports of the Generalitat Valenciana" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ANEXO I, Lugares protegidos, Regiones marinas, Unidades administrativas, ANEXO III, Infraestructuras. The listing shows 2012-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
